detail: Full summary: The pre-release adversarial review workflow earned its cost: it caught the sqlite backend's duplicate scopeless-handoff match (the file-backend fix alone would have shipped broken for every DEFAULT-backend store), the record-tools drop of supersedes_dangling (the default surface is the only path most installs have), the de-boost deflating total_matched membership, the TF-vs-cosine scale mismatch, and the negative-cosine ranking inversion — two of those were bugs in my fixes to its own earlier findings; review-of-fixes is not optional on this codebase
